label: localised, edit failed
justification: Loop evidence holds from call 51, which printed the last 200 characters of cut-off generations showing verbatim looping. Call 58 then counted repeated token sequences in the failing traces. A locus tied to that evidence first appears at call 105. It compared layer-23 MLP activations between finished (stop) and cut-off looping generations and found neuron 22 much more active in the looping ones. Call 259 later compared layer-23 heads 2 and 6 self-attention between a Wait-loop text and a boxed-completion text. Calls 66-69 and 117 looked at attention on failing traces only, which does not separate looping from non-looping. No submitted edit repaired the failure: every edit was reverted or left at about base level (7.4% on the final MATH-500 score), below the 0.29 threshold. The edits were A_log shifts, gate suppression of neurons 22/46/19/107/94 and others, boosts of neurons 40 and 96, o_proj scaling of heads 2 and 6, and dt_bias reductions in layers 21 and 22. The final dt_bias plus o_proj configuration scored 7.8% in call 358 and was then dropped.
edits_tried: A_log +1.0 in early linear-attn layers; layer 23 MLP gate suppression of neurons 22/46/19/107/94 and others; neuron 40 and 96 boosts; layer 23 o_proj heads 2,6 scaled 0.2-0.6x; dt_bias reductions in layers 21/22; combined dt_bias + o_proj
